meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先提问了解你的工作内容,再提出一套笔记分类(观察类型和概念标签),经你批准后写入 claude-mem 的自定义模式文件并激活;若你选择,还会配置 Telegram 通知,最后重启工作进程并确认新模式已生效。
howto.when: 当你说要自定义 claude-mem 记住什么、创建或更改模式、加观察类型或标签等时触发,即使你没用“模式”这个词。

say.text: 我要为法律学习创建一个模式,记判例和考试陷阱。
say.note: Claude 会先问你的工作场景,再提分类建议。

say.text: 给我设一个记录生产事故的模式,并加上 Telegram 通知。
say.note: 等分类批准后会配置通知并重启验证。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude interviews you about your work, proposes a note taxonomy (observation types and concept tags), then writes and activates a custom claude-mem mode file after your approval. It can also set up Telegram alerts, restart the worker, and verify that the new mode is active.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, even if you never say the word "mode."

say_en.text: I want a mode for law study that records case holdings and exam traps.
say_en.note: Claude will interview you first and suggest a taxonomy.

say_en.text: Set up a mode for production incidents and send me Telegram alerts.
say_en.note: After approval it will configure alerts, restart, and verify.
